items.title: Hoodie Teens
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Show off your best fashion with these best of the best hoodies.

items.title: Crazy Haired Teens!
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Nothing is crazy about fashion, but your hair might be!

items.title: Neon Madness
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Glow into the night with these crazy lights that would make anyone mad.

items.title: Hoodie Hackers
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: "We're in". Only the best of both fashion and hacking can get through. Cool sunglasses are required.

items.title: Athletes
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
It's time to exercise, with the help of the coolest athlete skins!
Choose your favourite sport and start your career today!

+ 16 athletes, ready for the daily dose of exercising!
+ Be fit, healthy and happy - that's what matters most.
+ 2 FREE skins included!

items.title: Gamer Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Ready to be the coolest gamer in town? These teens play video games and take an interest in fashion. Enjoy extravagant clothes to shine during your games!

- 12 trendy gamer skins
- By inPixel & Evershapes

items.title: Football Guys
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Do you like soccer? Then these teen footballer skins are for you! Enjoy these luxurious soccer player clothes and show them to your friends! 

- 12 trendy soccer skins
- By inPixel & Evershapes

items.title: Redwood Adventure
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Start your survival adventure in this redwood biome! Explore the villages around or build a house on the highest tree.

+Perfect to start your survival adventure
+Custom redwood biome
+By FallStudios

items.title: Millionaire Winter Mansion
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You want to live in a big mansion? Now you have the opportunity!
Live in one of the furnished houses or decorate your own. With Millionaire Mansion you get the perfect start for your survival adventure!

+By FallStudios

items.title: Alien
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Become an extraterrestrial and explore the outer reaches of space. Though your home is lightyears away, you are not alone.

items.title: Racers
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: There is not a single raceway you have not conquered. When the tires hit the pavement, your opponents are left in the dust. You are more than a racer. You are speed.

items.title: Spring Vacation
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Spring is coming and these outfits are ready! After a long and chilly winter, these skins are perfect for going out and enjoying the bright sunshine of Minecraft. Everybody loves a vacation, have fun on your trip!

+ 20 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Cute and unique skins to wear with your friends!
+ Collect all Spring-themed skin packs!

items.title: Rainbow Fashionista
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Teens are ready to show off their free spirit! Celebrate virtual pride and meet any part of the rainbow! Hangout with your friends and talk about the latest fashion trends and have fun. Find your free true self while you're starting a new Minecraft adventure!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 Rainbow themed skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Cover UP!
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Cover up! Get ready for your next big Minecraft adventure and be the most modern teen in the city. These masks can hide your identity! In your free time, hang out in the city with your friends and become the next fashion guru. Put on your mask and hide from everyone!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 masked skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Astronauts & Aliens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you an astronaut or an alien? Choose your side and be among us!

+ 13 skins included!
+ Roleplay ready!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Gamer Mobs
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
These mobs are no noobs, they're pro gamers and the sky is the limit! They're ready to place some blocks, do some mining, and if they're lucky enough, find some diamonds!

This skin pack has 8 skins including the following game mobs:

- Creeper
- Zombie
- Enderman
- Slime
- Ghast
- Pigman
- Spider
- Skeleton

items.title: School Uniforms: Teen Edition
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Get stylish with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Tired of trying to put together a nice outfit in the morning? Looking for something a bit more formal? Our newest pack has ten new outfits to have you looking ready to take on the world!

items.title: Rainbow Base
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Introducing your brand new home: your very own rainbow base! Kick-back in one of the many brightly colored rooms, tend to your crops in the indoor farm, or challenge your friends to an epic game of parkour!

+ Includes an amazing rainbow castle with many rooms to explore (including a parkour course!)
+ Survival spawn designed for roleplay
+ Published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Spaced Out
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Check out these galactic onesies! Look cute in a space-themed outfit that's out of this world! 

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Look cute and match your friends!
+ Collect all galaxy skins!

items.title: Luxury Mansion
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Become the owner of this gorgeous luxury mansion. Tour the colorful gardens, fill your large garage with fancy cars, and decorate the interior with custom modern items! Fly over your mansion with your very own helicopter and ride your jetski around the lake below the house.

+ Custom vehicles to drive around the map! 
+ Custom textures included!
+ Four skins included!

items.title: Wolf Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The full moon is coming! Turn into a wolf on a full moon night and embark on an adventure!

- 10 unique teen wolf skins!
- Perfect for roleplay!
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios

items.title: Crazy Clowns
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Watch out! Crazy Clowns have escaped and they are out in the open streets of Minecraft. If they find you, you can either run away and hide or be a seeker and join them. Choose wisely...

- 24 spooky and epic skins!
+ 1 free skin!
- Perfect for role-playing
- By Pixelusion and Lostduckies

items.title: Fantastic Professions
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Do you want to become a lumberjack? How about a chef? Have you ever considered that you might like to be a builder, but you can't decide between that or a racecar driver? Well now you don't have to decide! You now have the opportunity to be all of these and more with this great skin pack!

- Twelve skins.
- Two skins free.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Lava Armor
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Pick up some incredible armor skins forged from the fiery depths of the Nether! The heat of the lava forges truly strong armor and the warriors who wear them don't burn under pressure. Be super cool yet fierce in your adventures.

- Cool armor skins
- Forged from lava
- Modern armor designs
- Perfect for teens
